_comment: Bursa Malaysia non-trading days. VERIFY EVERY YEAR against the official Bursa
Islamic holidays depend on moon sighting and are frequently gazetted late, and Bursa
occasionally trades a half day or closes for an ad-hoc national event.
Set "verified": true for a year only once you have checked it against Bursa's list.
The calendar refuses to run for a year that is absent, so the bot fails loudly
rather than placing orders on a closed market.
